<!doctype html>
<html lang="en" data-theme="matrix">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8"/>
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"/>
<title>MICRO-ASXR — Demo</title>
<style>
/* ==================== K'UHUL EXECUTION PATTERNS (Atomic Ops) ==================== */
    [⟁flex],.b-f{display:flex}[⟁grid],.b-g{display:grid}[⟁block],.b-b{display:block}[⟁inline],.b-i{display:inline}
    [⟁row],.b-fr{flex-direction:row}[⟁col],.b-fc{flex-direction:column}[⟁wrap],.b-wrap{flex-wrap:wrap}
    [⟁center],.b-gc{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}[⟁acenter],.b-aic{align-items:center}[⟁jcenter],.b-jcc{justify-content:center}
    [⟁p1],.p-1{padding:var(--s1)}[⟁p2],.p-2{padding:var(--s2)}[⟁p3],.p-3{padding:var(--s3)}[⟁p4],.p-4{padding:var(--s4)}
    [⟁m1],.m-1{margin:var(--s1)}[⟁m2],.m-2{margin:var(--s2)}[⟁m3],.m-3{margin:var(--s3)}[⟁m4],.m-4{margin:var(--s4)}
    [⟁g1],.gap-1{gap:var(--s1)}[⟁g2],.gap-2{gap:var(--s2)}[⟁g3],.gap-3{gap:var(--s3)}[⟁g4],.gap-4{gap:var(--s4)}
    [⟁border],.border{border:1px solid var(--border)}[⟁border-accent],.border-accent{border:1px solid var(--accent)}[⟁rounded],.rounded{border-radius:var(--r2)}
    [⟁bg0],.bg-0{background:var(--bg-0)}[⟁bg1],.bg-1{background:var(--bg-1)}[⟁bg2],.bg-2{background:var(--bg-2)}[⟁bg-accent],.bg-accent{background:var(--accent)}
    [⟁text],.text{color:var(--fg-0)}[⟁muted],.text-muted{color:var(--fg-1)}[⟁accent],.text-accent{color:var(--accent)}

    /* ==================== XCFE CONTROL FLOW (C@@L primitives) ==================== */
    [atomic-block="@if_then_else"],.flow-if{--control-flow:"conditional";--evaluation-state:"pending";display:none;padding:var(--s3);border-left:3px solid var(--accent);background:rgba(22,242,170,.05);border-radius:var(--r2)}
    [atomic-block="@if_then_else"][data-condition="true"],.flow-if.active{display:block;animation:block-activate .3s ease-out}
    [atomic-block="@loop"],.flow-loop{--control-flow:"recursive";--iteration-count:0;--max-iterations:100;animation:loop-pulse calc(1s/var(--velocity,1)) infinite;padding:var(--s3);border-left:3px solid rgba(22,242,170,.7);background:rgba(22,242,170,.05);border-radius:var(--r2)}
    [atomic-block="@dispatch"],.flow-dispatch{--control-flow:"routing";--route-target:"";--route-state:"idle";cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s ease;padding:var(--s3);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--r2);background:var(--panel)}
    [atomic-block="@dispatch"]:hover,.flow-dispatch:hover{--route-state:"hover";background:rgba(22,242,170,.10);border-color:var(--accent);transform:translateX(2px)}
    [atomic-block="@microagent"],.agent-micro{--agent-type:"micro";--agent-state:"idle";--agent-processing:0;position:relative;overflow:hidden;padding:var(--s3);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--r2);background:var(--panel)}
    .agent-micro::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(22,242,170,.1),transparent);transform:translateX(-100%);animation:agent-process calc(2s*var(--agent-processing,0)) ease-out}

    /* ==================== Execution Folds ==================== */
    [execution-fold="Pop"],.fold-pop{--execution-phase:"loading";--fold-state:"entering";opacity:0;transform:translateY(-20px);animation:fold-pop .3s ease-out forwards}
    [execution-fold="Wo"],.fold-wo{--execution-phase:"binding";--fold-state:"contextualizing";border-left:3px solid rgba(22,242,170,.5);padding-left:var(--s3);background:rgba(22,242,170,.05)}
    [execution-fold="Sek"],.fold-sek{--execution-phase:"executing";--fold-state:"processing";animation:fold-sek .4s ease-in-out infinite;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(22,242,170,.1),transparent)}

    /* ==================== Agents (kernel/runtime/physics) ==================== */
    .agent-kernel{--agent-capability:"system_governance";--agent-priority:"highest";border:2px solid var(--accent);background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(22,242,170,.1),rgba(22,242,170,.05));padding:var(--s4);border-radius:var(--r3)}
    .agent-runtime{--agent-capability:"resource_distribution";--resource-cpu:var(--runtime-cpu);--resource-gpu:var(--runtime-gpu);--resource-tpu:var(--runtime-tpu);padding:var(--s4);border-radius:var(--r3);background:var(--panel)}
    .agent-physics{
      --agent-capability:"motion_simulation";
      transform:translate(calc(var(--px,0)*1px),calc(var(--py,0)*1px)) rotate(calc(var(--rot,0)*1deg));
      transition:transform calc(.1s/var(--velocity,1));
      padding:var(--s4);border-radius:var(--r3);background:var(--panel)
    }

    /* ==================== SPECIAL EFFECTS ==================== */
    .text-gradient{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--accent),var(--accent2));-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent}
    .electric-border{border:2px solid transparent;background:linear-gradient(var(--bg-0),var(--bg-0)) padding-box,linear-gradient(90deg,var(--accent),var(--accent2)) border-box}
    .neon{text-shadow:0 0 10px var(--accent),0 0 20px var(--accent),0 0 30px var(--accent)}

    /* ==================== GAME UI ==================== */
    .health-bar{width:100%;height:4px;border-radius:2px;background:var(--bg-1);overflow:hidden}
    .health-fill{height:100%;background:var(--danger);transition:width .3s ease}
    .health-bar-pulse{animation:health-pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite}

    /* ==================== OS Window ==================== */
    .os-window{background:var(--bg-0);border-radius:var(--r3);border:1px solid var(--border);box-shadow:0 18px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.35);overflow:hidden}
    .os-titlebar{background:var(--panel);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);padding:var(--s2) var(--s3);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}
    .os-controls{display:flex;gap:var(--s1)}
    .os-control{width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%}
    .os-control.close{background:var(--danger)}.os-control.minimize{background:var(--hazard)}.os-control.maximize{background:var(--success)}

    /* ==================== Data viz ==================== */
    .signal-strength{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:2px;height:20px}
    .signal-bar{width:3px;background:var(--accent);opacity:.3;border-radius:1px}
    .signal-bar.active{opacity:1}
    .entropy-visual{width:100%;height:2px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--bg-1) 0%,var(--accent) calc(var(--entropy,0)*100%),var(--bg-1) 100%);border-radius:1px}

    /* ==================== Accessibility ==================== */
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){
      *,*::before,*::after{animation-duration:.01ms!important;animation-iteration-count:1!important;transition-duration:.01ms!important}
    }

    /* ==================== Animations ==================== */
    @keyframes block-activate{0%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-10px)}100%{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
    @keyframes loop-pulse{0%,100%{background:rgba(22,242,170,.05)}50%{background:rgba(22,242,170,.15)}}
    @keyframes agent-process{0%{transform:translateX(-100%)}100%{transform:translateX(100%)}}
    @keyframes fold-pop{0%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-20px)}100%{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
    @keyframes fold-sek{0%,100%{background-position:-200% 0}100%{background-position:200% 0}}
    @keyframes health-pulse{0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:.7}}

    /* ==================== GLYPH RUNTIME (universal) ==================== */
    [data-g]{
      --g-size:24;
      --g-w:calc(var(--g-size)*1px);
      --g-h:calc(var(--g-size)*1px);
      display:inline-block;width:var(--g-w);height:var(--g-h);
      background:var(--g-data) center/contain no-repeat;
      flex-shrink:0;vertical-align:middle;
      filter:var(--g-filter);
    }
    [data-g][data-size="xs"]{--g-size:12}[data-g][data-size="sm"]{--g-size:16}[data-g][data-size="md"]{--g-size:24}[data-g][data-size="lg"]{--g-size:32}[data-g][data-size="xl"]{--g-size:48}
    [data-g-animate]{animation:var(--g-anim-name) var(--g-anim-dur,1s) var(--g-anim-timing,ease) var(--g-anim-count,infinite)}
    [data-g-animate="spin"]{--g-anim-name:g-spin}[data-g-animate="pulse"]{--g-anim-name:g-pulse;--g-anim-dur:2s}[data-g-animate="bounce"]{--g-anim-name:g-bounce;--g-anim-dur:.5s}[data-g-animate="float"]{--g-anim-name:g-float;--g-anim-dur:3s}
    @keyframes g-spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}@keyframes g-pulse{0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:.5}}@keyframes g-bounce{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-5px)}}@keyframes g-float{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-3px)}}
    [data-g-color="accent"]{--g-filter:drop-shadow(0 0 10px rgba(22,242,170,.35))}
    [data-g-color="danger"]{--g-filter:drop-shadow(0 0 10px rgba(255,107,107,.35))}
    [data-g-color="hazard"]{--g-filter:drop-shadow(0 0 10px rgba(255,179,0,.35))}
    [data-theme="dark"] [data-g]{filter:invert(100%) brightness(200%)}

/* demo-only scaffold */
:root{ --bg-0:#020409; --bg-1:#050912; --panel:rgba(255,255,255,.04); --border:rgba(97,231,255,.35); --fg-0:#e9fbff; --fg-1:rgba(233,251,255,.78); --accent:#16f2aa; --accent2:#61e7ff; --r2:12px; --r3:18px; --s1:8px; --s2:12px; --s3:16px; --s4:20px; --hazard:#ffb300; --danger:#ff6b6b; --success:#00d9a6; --entropy:.15; }
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg-0);color:var(--fg-0);font:600 14px/1.35 ui-monospace,Menlo,Consolas,"Cascadia Code",monospace;}
.wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns: 1fr;gap:12px;padding:12px;}
.card{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);border-radius:var(--r3);padding:16px;}
.row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);font-size:12px;color:var(--fg-1)}
.btn{appearance:none;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16);background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);color:var(--fg-0);border-radius:12px;padding:9px 12px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:900;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.btn:hover{border-color:rgba(22,242,170,.55);transform:translateY(-1px)}
.meter{height:2px;border-radius:2px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--bg-1) 0%, var(--accent) calc(var(--entropy,0)*100%), var(--bg-1) 100%)}
</style>

<body>
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="card">
      <div class="row">
        <span data-g="⟁" data-size="lg" data-g-animate="pulse" data-g-color="accent"></span>
